description: Starter content shipped with the site. The app fetches these with a plain relative request — no token needed. Add your own by dropping a file in presets/plans or presets/exercises and adding an entry here.

plans.name: Couch to 10K — 26-Week Conservative Build
plans.description: Three sessions a week from sedentary to 10K-equivalent duration. Ramps impact slowly, deloads every fourth week, and puts lower-leg strength work in every session. Built around a shin-splint history.

plans.name: Example Plan (edit me)
plans.description: A tiny one-week plan demonstrating every target kind — reps with a range, duration with a variant level, distance with a pace, and intervals. The best starting point for writing your own.

exercisePacks.name: Running & Calisthenics
exercisePacks.description: Running warm-ups, shin and calf injury-prevention work, and a full calisthenics skill ladder (pull-up, push-up, dip, squat, L-sit, front lever, human flag) with progression variants.

exercisePacks.name: Barbell Basics
exercisePacks.description: The six foundational barbell lifts — squat, deadlift, bench, overhead press, row, and RDL — each with a regression ladder and loading guidance.

exercisePacks.name: Dumbbell Essentials
exercisePacks.description: A complete home-gym set covering squat, hinge, push, pull, press, and lunge with nothing but dumbbells and a bench.

exercisePacks.name: Cardio & Cross-Training
exercisePacks.description: Low- and no-impact aerobic options — bike, swim, row, incline walk, elliptical, and jump rope — for building fitness while managing impact load.
